name: personalAccessToken
label: Personal Access Token
help: A Figma personal access token. Generate one from your Figma account settings under **Settings > Security > Personal access tokens**. Requires at least the `projects:read`, `file_metadata:read`, `file_versions:read`, `file_comments:read` and `team_library_content:read` scopes.

name: teamId
label: Team ID
help: The numeric ID of the Figma team to monitor. Found in the team's URL: `figma.com/files/team/<TEAM_ID>/...`. To monitor more than one team, add this plugin again with a different Team ID.
